name: pipaya-extension-guard
description: Blocks destructive shell commands (wiping / or ~, formatting or overwriting a disk, fork bombs) before they run.
author: dohwi

descriptions.en: Stops a bash command before it runs when it would wipe / or ~, format or overwrite a disk, fork-bomb the machine or change the permissions of the whole disk. Each family can be switched off below.
descriptions.ko: bash 명령이 /·~ 전체 삭제, 디스크 포맷·덮어쓰기, 포크 폭탄, 디스크 전체 권한 변경을 하려 하면 실행 전에 막습니다. 항목별로 아래에서 끌 수 있습니다.

settings.label: Block wiping disks and home
settings.description: Stops commands that delete a whole disk or home directory, such as rm -rf / and rm -rf ~.

settings.label: Block formatting or overwriting disks
settings.description: Stops commands that format or overwrite a disk, such as mkfs, dd of=/dev/sdX and > /dev/nvme0n1.

settings.label: Block fork bombs
settings.description: Stops commands that multiply processes without end, such as :(){ :|:& };:.

settings.label: Block permission changes on disks and home
settings.description: Stops chmod -R and chown -R applied to all of / or ~.

ko.Stops commands that delete a whole disk: rm -rf /, rm -rf ~ 처럼 디스크나 홈 디렉터리 전체를 지우는 명령을 막습니다.
ko.Stops commands that format or overwrite: mkfs, dd of=/dev/sdX, > /dev/nvme0n1 처럼 디스크를 포맷하거나 덮어쓰는 명령을 막습니다.
ko.Stops commands that multiply processes w: :(){ :|:& };: 처럼 프로세스를 무한히 늘리는 명령을 막습니다.
ko.Stops chmod -R and chown -R applied to a: chmod -R, chown -R 을 / 나 ~ 전체에 적용하는 명령을 막습니다.
